description: This file implements the MessageUnit class for message serialization, updating control states, managing the singleton instance, opening and closing message dispatchers, and pushing messages within the WPEFramework messaging system.

classes.name: MessageUnit
classes.description: Singleton class managing message serialization, control updates, and message dispatching within the WPEFramework.

classes.name: Handler
classes.description: Internal handler classes used for processing controls during serialization, updating, opening, and closing.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes control information into a buffer, returning the offset.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates control states based on provided metadata and settings.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates control states based on internal settings.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of MessageUnit.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Initializes MessageUnit with a path, configuration, and mode settings.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Initializes MessageUnit with a specific instance ID.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes and cleans up the MessageUnit, destroying controls and resetting dispatcher.

methods.name: Default
methods.description: Checks if a control is enabled by default based on settings.

methods.name: Push
methods.description: Pushes a message of any type and its information to the buffer or directly outputs it.
